correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact Gaussian multiindex monomial moments and kernel series; factorial-scaled coefficient ratios force the only finite-zero order-one Hadamard candidate to be exp(a t), contradicted by the coefficient limit for 0<eps<1. For q small, geometric exponential representation, half-plane zero exclusion and Rouché provide a unique simple negative root at a t=log(q)/(1-r)-q^(1-r)/(1-r)+O(q^(2(1-r))), and nearest-zero modulus has the corresponding sharp log scale. Hessian eigenvalues a+Delta p and a+Delta p-Delta^2 s p(1-p) yield a-Delta eta/e uniform lower bound. Endpoints eps=0,1 have zero-free kernels; off-diagonal only. Independent high-precision root at eps=1e-4,a=1,b=2: a t=-18.44066426570005, h(t) residual 1.4e-56, shift -0.02018353175 against leading -0.020001000075. Finite check does not replace infinite proof.
